architecture_decisions.decision: Use block-based compression with configurable block sizes (16, 64, 256, 1024 KiB; default 64 KiB)
architecture_decisions.reason: Limits working memory under 4 MiB, enables independent block decoding, and allows mixed methods within one file.

architecture_decisions.decision: Use fixed-width 16-bit LZW codes with 65536 dictionary cap
architecture_decisions.reason: Simplifies implementation and avoids variable-width code complexity in version 1.

architecture_decisions.decision: Use adaptive block-level selection among RAW, Huffman, and LZW
architecture_decisions.reason: Prevents compression overhead from increasing stored size and ensures optimal algorithm selection per block.

architecture_decisions.decision: Use SHA-256 for file-level integrity and CRC-32 for block-level integrity
architecture_decisions.reason: Provides fast block validation and strong cryptographic verification of exact lossless recovery.

architecture_decisions.decision: Strict path traversal validation in archive extraction
architecture_decisions.reason: Rejects absolute paths, parent-directory traversals (..), and drive letters to ensure filesystem security.

archive_format_decisions.decision: Mandate little-endian byte ordering for archive headers, fields, and LZW codes

algorithm_decisions.decision: Huffman deterministic tree ordering using (frequency, minSymbol, order)
algorithm_decisions.reason: Guarantees reproducible canonical tree generation across platforms.

algorithm_decisions.decision: Freeze LZW dictionary at 65536 entries and continue encoding without clearing

changelog.entry: Completed review of M1 (Huffman) and M2 (LZW).
Fixed LZW little-endian packing and added memory safety bounds.
Implemented BitWriter, BitReader, BinaryIO, Checksum (CRC32/SHA256), Block chunking, and Adaptive selection. All 12 engine tests passed.
Implemented .forge archive format, ArchiveWriter, ArchiveReader, path traversal protection, SHA-256 verification. All 13 archive tests passed.
Implemented BenchmarkSuite, CSV/Markdown export, and Qt Widgets MainWindow desktop GUI interfacing via engine APIs. All 13 benchmark tests passed.
Completed comprehensive test suites (62 tests), documentation suite (README + 4 docs), CMakeLists.txt updates, and submission readiness.
